title: 托福官方套题 01 · 口语

tasks.sample: The main reading area is straight ahead.
Computer stations are for student use.
You can find most textbooks in the reference section to our left.
The study rooms can be reserved online at our website.
You can find the circulation desk next to the front entrance.
When you are looking for help, please ask for assistance from someone located here.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for joining this study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about how you manage your time. First, can you tell me about one or two activities you do when you are behind schedule and want to catch up.
(Interviewer) I see. Often when trying to stay on a time schedule, people either want to keep a calendar, or they want to set a timer. Which do you prefer, and why?

(Interviewer) Interesting. Many recent surveys have shown that the general level of tardiness amongst workers has been increasing over the last 10 years. What do you think might be some of the causes of this increase, and why?

(Interviewer) Good points. For my final question, I'd like to ask about workplace scheduling. Keeping employees on task and on time is important for quality of work and staff retention. Do you think employers should be directly involved in helping their employees manage their time? Why or why not?
